eyebrow: The four flows this project supports
code:
1. list    seller approves marketplace, calls listItem(price)
2. buy     buyer pays exact price -> royalty + seller paid, NFT moves
3. cancel  seller pulls the listing any time before it sells
4. discover  anyone queries active listings via the indexer, not the chain
caption: Buy is one transaction: payment and transfer succeed together or not at all.
